english: The Song of songs, which is Solomon’s.

paite: Atawpna kam in hon tawp hen aw! Na itna lah uain sang in ahoihzaw ngal a.
heading: La Khatna / Numei
english: Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth; for your love is better than wine.

paite: Na kinuhte'n gimlim hoihtak anei a, na min kinuh butkhiak bang ahi a, huaiziak in nungak siangthoute'n nang ahon it uhi.
english: Your oils have a pleasing fragrance. Your name is oil poured out, therefore the virgins love you.

paite: Hon kai in, nang ka hon delh ding; kumpipa'n adantante sung ah ahon pita a, nang ah ka kipak un nuam ka sa ding uh, uain sang in na itna ka genkhe mun zaw ding ua; adikte'n nang ahon it uhi.
english: Take me away with you. Let’s hurry. The king has brought me into his rooms. Friends We will be glad and rejoice in you. We will praise your love more than wine! Beloved They are right to love you.

paite: Ka vom a, himahleh ka mel ahoih hi, Aw nou Jerusalem tanute, Kedar puaninte bang, Solomon puankhaite bang.
english: I am dark, but lovely, you daughters of Jerusalem, like Kedar’s tents, like Solomon’s curtains.

paite: Ka vom ziak in hon en ke'n, ni in ahon hai ziak in. Ka nu tapate ka tung ah athangpai ua, grephuante kem in ahon bawl ua; himahleh keimah grephuan leng ka kem kei.
english: Don’t stare at me because I am dark, because the sun has scorched me. My mother’s sons were angry with me. They made me keeper of the vineyards. I haven’t kept my own vineyard.

paite: Hon hilh ve, aw nang ka kha in a-it, na ganhon vakna mun, sun lai a na khawlsakna mun; bang ding a na kithuahpihte lak a ganhon kiang a maituam bang a kei om ding ka hia?
english: Tell me, you whom my soul loves, where you graze your flock, where you rest them at noon; for why should I be as one who is veiled beside the flocks of your companions?

paite: Na theih keileh, Aw nang numeite lak a kilawmpen, ganhonte khapte zui in kuankhia inla, belamchingte puanin kiang ah na kelnoute vak in.
heading: Pasal
english: If you don’t know, most beautiful among women, follow the tracks of the sheep. Graze your young goats beside the shepherds’ tents.

paite: Aw ka it, Pharaoh kangtalaite lak a sakol toh ka hon teh hi.
english: I have compared you, my love, to a steed in Pharaoh’s chariots.

paite: Na kicheinate toh na biang akilawm a, na ngawng suangmantam khite toh.
english: Your cheeks are beautiful with earrings, your neck with strings of jewels.

paite: Dangka-eng samphekte dangka siatte toh ka hon bawlsak ding uh.
english: We will make you earrings of gold, with studs of silver.

paite: Kumpipa adohkan a atut lai in, ka spiknardi gimlim in anamtuina asawlkhia.
heading: Numei
english: While the king sat at his table, my perfume spread its fragrance.

paite: Ka ngaihnou kei a ding in murrah gimlim bang ahi a, ka nawite kikal a om.
english: My beloved is to me a sachet of myrrh, that lies between my breasts.

paite: Ka ngaihnou kei a ding in Engedi grephuante a henna pak bawk bang ahi.
english: My beloved is to me a cluster of henna blossoms from the vineyards of En Gedi.

paite: Ngai in, na kilawm, ka it; ngai in, na kilawm; na mitte vahui bang ahi uh.
heading: Pasal
english: Behold, you are beautiful, my love. Behold, you are beautiful. Your eyes are like doves.

paite: Ngai in, na kilawm ka ngaihnou, ahi, anuam; i tutna nem leng ahing.
heading: Numei
english: Behold, you are beautiful, my beloved, yes, pleasant; and our couch is verdant.

paite: Sidar singte i inkamte ahi a, i insunte meilah singte ahi.
english: The beams of our house are cedars. Our rafters are firs.
